sloka: तदानय समीपं मे शीघ्रमेनां विभीषण ।सीता पश्यतु मामेषा सुहृद्गणवृतं स्थितम् ।। ६.११७.२९ ।।
transliteration: tadānaya samīpaṁ me śīghramenāṁ vibhīṣaṇa ।sītā paśyatu māmeṣā suhṛdgaṇavṛtaṁ sthitam ।। 6.117.29 ।।

translations.english: "Sita is in distress and in a highly miserable situation. Her appearance is no fault especially in my presence."
